cards.ex: He decided to throw caution to the wind and invest all his savings in the startup.
cards.exUz: U ehtiyotkorlikni chetga surib, butun jamg'armasini startapga sarmoya qilishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfga e'tibor bermasdan, o'ylamasdan harakat qilish, risk qilish.

cards.ex: Driving that fast on these roads is just flirting with danger.
cards.exUz: Bu yo'llarda bunchalik tez haydash shunchaki xavf bilan o'ynashishdir.
cards.uzDef: O'zingni bilib turib xavfli vaziyatga qo'yish, xavfga yaqinlashish.

cards.ex: I'm not sure about the weather, so I'm going to play it safe and take an umbrella.
cards.exUz: Ob-havo haqida ishonchim yo'q, shuning uchun men ehtiyot bo'lib, soyabon olaman.
cards.uzDef: Xavf tug'dirmaslik uchun eng ehtiyotkorona yo'lni tanlash.

cards.ex: The manager was in the firing line after the company's poor performance.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning yomon ko'rsatkichlaridan so'ng menejer tanqid ostida qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Tanqid, ayblov yoki xavfga duchor bo'lgan vaziyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: You need to get a grip on the situation before it spirals out of control.
cards.exUz: Vaziyat nazoratdan chiqib ketishidan oldin, uni qo'lga olishing kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zingni qo'lga olmoq, vaziyatni nazorat qilishga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: We need to bridge the gap in security before a serious breach occurs.
cards.exUz: Jiddiy buzilish sodir bo'lishidan oldin xavfsizlikdagi farqni bartaraf etishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Xavfni kamaytirish uchun mavjud bo'lgan kamchilikni to'ldirish.

cards.ex: Let's clear the air and talk about what went wrong.
cards.exUz: Keling, muammoni hal qilamiz va nima noto'g'ri ketganini muhokama qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki noqulay vaziyatni hal qilish, tushunmovchilikni bartaraf etish.

cards.ex: The project failed, so we're back to square one.
cards.exUz: Loyiha muvaffaqiyatsiz tugadi, shuning uchun biz boshidan boshlayapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Barcha harakatlar samarasiz bo'lganidan keyin boshidan boshlashga majbur bo'lish.

cards.ex: The company managed to weather the storm of the financial crisis.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya moliyaviy inqirozning qiyinchiliklarini yengishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki xavfli vaziyatni muvaffaqiyatli o'tkazish.

cards.ex: Security forces are on high alert after the terrorist threat.
cards.exUz: Terrorchilik xavfidan so'ng xavfsizlik kuchlari yuqori tayyorgarlikda.
cards.uzDef: Xavfni kutish va unga tayyor bo'lish uchun yuqori darajadagi e'tibor.

cards.ex: I don't want to put my children in harm's way.
cards.exUz: Men farzandlarimni xavf ostiga qo'yishni xohlamayman.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli vaziyatga tushib qolish yoki xavfga duchor bo'lish.

cards.ex: Many small businesses fell by the wayside during the recession.
cards.exUz: Resessiya davrida ko'plab kichik bizneslar orqada qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklar tufayli muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrash.

cards.ex: His jokes were a bit close to the bone, considering the circumstances.
cards.exUz: Uning hazillari vaziyatni hisobga olgan holda biroz o'ta xavfli edi.
cards.uzDef: O'ta xavfli yoki sezgir mavzuga yaqinlashish.

cards.ex: The government is trying to ring-fence funding for education.
cards.exUz: Hukumat ta'lim uchun mablag'larni himoya qilishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Xavfni kamaytirish maqsadida biror narsani himoya qilish.

cards.ex: It was a dicey situation, but we managed to get through it.
cards.exUz: Bu xavfli vaziyat edi, lekin biz uni yengishga muvaffaq bo'ldik.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli, noaniq yoki ishonchsiz vaziyat.

cards.ex: He caused the accident but somehow got off scot-free.
cards.exUz: U avtohalokatga sabab bo'ldi, lekin qandaydir tarzda jazosiz qutuldi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday jazo olmasdan yoki oqibatlarga duch kelmasdan xavfli vaziyatdan qutulish.

cards.ex: Taking the job was a no-brainer; the pay was great and the work was interesting.
cards.exUz: Ishga kirish aniq qaror edi; maoshi ajoyib va ishi qiziqarli edi.
cards.uzDef: Xavf yo'qligi sababli oson va ravshan qaror.

cards.ex: After the investigation, he was finally in the clear.
cards.exUz: Tergovdan so'ng, u nihoyat xavfsiz holatda edi.
cards.uzDef: Xavf yoki gumondan xoli bo'lgan holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The suspect was placed under surveillance by the police.
cards.exUz: Gumonlanuvchi politsiya tomonidan kuzatuv ostiga olindi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfsizlik sababli doimiy kuzatuv ostida bo'lish.

cards.ex: We decided to roll the dice and invest in the new market.
cards.exUz: Biz tavakkal qilib, yangi bozorga sarmoya kiritishga qaror qildik.
cards.uzDef: Natijasi noaniq bo'lgan tavakkalchilikka qo'l urish.

cards.ex: Make sure you document everything to cover your back.
cards.exUz: O'zingizni himoya qilish uchun hamma narsani hujjatlashtiring.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni himoya qilish uchun zarur choralarni ko'rish, xavfsizlikni ta'minlash.

cards.ex: Dealing with him is like walking a minefield; you never know what will set him off.
cards.exUz: U bilan muomala qilish minalangan maydonda yurishga o'xshaydi; uning g'azabini nima qo'zg'ashini hech qachon bilmaysiz.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli va ehtiyotkorlikni talab qiladigan vaziyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: I didn't know the answer, so I just took a stab in the dark.
cards.exUz: Men javobni bilmasdim, shuning uchun shunchaki taxmin qildim.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday ma'lumotga ega bo'lmasdan taxminiy urinish qilish.

cards.ex: I'm going to chance my arm and ask for a promotion.
cards.exUz: Men omadimni sinab ko'rmoqchiman va lavozimimni ko'tarishni so'rayman.
cards.uzDef: Garchi muvaffaqiyatga erishish ehtimoli kam bo'lsa ham, biror narsani urinib ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: I don't want to rock the boat by complaining about the new policy.
cards.exUz: Men yangi siyosatdan shikoyat qilib vaziyatni buzishni xohlamayman.
cards.uzDef: Mavjud vaziyatni buzadigan yoki o'zgartiradigan harakat qilish.

cards.ex: His actions fly in the face of company policy.
cards.exUz: Uning harakatlari kompaniya siyosatiga zid keladi.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilingan qoidalar yoki odatlarga ochiqchasiga qarshi chiqish.

cards.ex: We need to cover all bases to ensure the project is a success.
cards.exUz: Loyiha muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishini ta'minlash uchun barcha mumkin bo'lgan choralarni ko'rishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun barcha mumkin bo'lgan choralarni ko'rish.

cards.ex: He raised the stakes by investing more money in the business.
cards.exUz: U biznesga ko'proq pul sarmoya kiritib, tavakkalni oshirdi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfni yoki mukofotni oshirish, vaziyatni jiddiylashtirish.

cards.ex: I think he's bitten off more than he can chew by taking on three projects at once.
cards.exUz: O'ylashimcha, u bir vaqtning o'zida uchta loyihani olib, imkoniyatidan tashqari ishni o'z zimmasiga oldi.
cards.uzDef: Qobiliyatingizdan ko'proq ishni o'z zimmangizga olish.

cards.ex: She's hedging her bets by applying to several universities.
cards.exUz: U bir nechta universitetga ariza berib, xatarni kamaytirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yo'qotish xavfini kamaytirish uchun bir nechta variantga ega bo'lish.
